question: When multiplying 3.24 by 0.006, how many significant figures should the result have?
solution:
The correct answer is __1**(Significant Figure)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Significant figures__ are the digits in a number that are meaningful in terms of accuracy or precision.
 
• The multiplication result is determined by the least number of significant figures in any factor.
 
• In 3.24, there are three significant figures.
 
• In 0.006, there is one significant figure.
 
• Thus, the result of the multiplication should have one significant figure.
 
• This rule ensures accuracy in scientific calculations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Significant Figures Rule:**
 
 
• Non-zero digits are always significant.
 
• Any zeros between significant digits are significant.
 
• Leading zeros are not significant.
 
• Trailing zeros in a decimal number are significant.
 
 
 
• **Scientific Calculations:**
 
 
• Accuracy and precision are crucial for maintaining reliability.
 
• Significant figures help in controlling errors in computations.
